text:
Maya (eng-oncall): short follow-up from the recent postmortem on repeated kv eviction spikes. need tight owners and a tracking plan so this doesn't slip. who can take what?
Ben (eng-sre): I can take the alert tuning and the recurring-pattern analysis. want to correlate eviction spikes with sequence length, client type, and rollout windows.
Lila (eng-ml): i'll own the regression additions: targeted prompt/regression sets + a small load test that varies prefix lengths. low-risk: start with 50 prompts and expand.
Oscar (product): product asks that we prioritize customer-facing regressions first (batch inference + streaming chat). also want ETA bundled into the roadmap.
Maya (eng-oncall): proposed split: Ben -> metrics/alerts + monthly pattern report; Lila -> regression suite + pre-merge golden prompts; Maya -> CI canary + staging run orchestration. deadlines?
Ben (eng-sre): pattern report first draft in 9 days. I'll add a new dashboard and two alerts: eviction-rate and cache-miss-rate.
Lila (eng-ml): regression initial PR with 50 prompts and a small scorer by day 7. will include categories: long-prefix, short-burst, mixed-concurrency.
Oscar (product): can you mark 2 of the prompts as "high-visibility" so we can run them on customer-facing PRs?
Lila (eng-ml): yes. will add tags `@high-vis` and include in pre-merge job.
Maya (eng-oncall): CI plan: create `ci/canary/kv-nightly` that runs in staging at 2am and a pre-merge smoke. I'll add circuitry for automatic rollback gating if eviction rate > threshold.
Ben (eng-sre): small note: don't make the rollback too sensitive. we'll tune with three days of data.
Lila (eng-ml): for scoring, i'll implement a delta-score and a small rubric: if token-level perplexity vs baseline + semantic divergence > threshold -> fail. i'll document false-positive handling.
Maya (eng-oncall): ops-bot: please create an epic and attach the tasks with owners/due-dates. we want canary in staging in 14 days, production guardrail before wide rollout in 6 weeks.
ops-bot: Epic created: EPI-2420 "kv-eviction-regression-program". Subtasks: EPI-2420-1 alert+tuning (Ben) due 1767090000, EPI-2420-2 regression-suite (Lila) due 1767060000, EPI-2420-3 staging-canary (Maya) due 1767096000.
Maya (eng-oncall): we also need a recurring ownership rotation for the monthly pattern report so it's not single-person. Ben, can you nominate backups?
Ben (eng-sre): i'll put a two-person rotation: Ben + whoever is oncall from eng-platform. adding to the ops calendar.
Lila (eng-ml): quick technical ask: can platform expose kv request histograms to the eval runner? having percentiles by prefix length would help.
Maya (eng-oncall): that's a platform task, Ben can coordinate with infra.
Ben (eng-sre): noted, I'll open infra ticket and link here.
Oscar (product): thanks team. once we have epics and dates, i'll update the roadmap and customer comms.
Maya (eng-oncall): summary: owners assigned, epic created, staging canary + pre-merge smoke planned, monthly rotation set up. reconvene in 6 days for status check. :thumbsup:
Lila (eng-ml): ack, starting on prompt curation now.
Ben (eng-sre): ack, will draft the dashboard early next week.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: status check in 6 days (1767050000).
